# The comm checkout port sets an explicit Mercurial mode in task producers and run configurations

This landing adds clone-with:hg to the owned comm-checkout task configurations and the toolchain/notification Python producers. The toolchain producer retains the field when it changes the runner to run-task and dispatches to upstream job configuration. Build, mach and nested repackage blocks have distinct consumers; their explicit data does not prove paired Gecko/taskgraph internals or a successful checkout. Later repository-type guards and the upload-symbols follow-up are separate phases. No graph or checkout was run, and this source does not set a rule for every future task.

Scope: Thunderbird taskgraph checkout wiring.
